contract.ordinarySearch: Reset every ordinary initial; no swap or one transposition. Preserve nonordinary initials except an E-key retroflex repair when needed. Separately enumerate all distinct three-retroflex assignments over EKSL containing E for b/n.
contract.neighborhood: Final single moves, pair swaps, key-group swaps, and A/E/O single or co-key group moves. Prioritize b/n lane and overall lane, alternating axes. Finite search.
